create_SiglipTextConfig: create a SiglipTextConfig instance with default text encoder settings for the Siglip model
create_SiglipVisionConfig: create a SiglipVisionConfig instance with default vision encoder settings for the Siglip model
create_SiglipConfig: create a SiglipConfig instance combining text and vision configs for the multimodal Siglip model
build_SiglipConfig_from_subconfigs: build a SiglipConfig from separate SiglipTextConfig and SiglipVisionConfig instances
initialize_SiglipConfig_defaults: initialize a SiglipConfig with default text and vision configs when subconfigs are None
